subject: [RFC PATCH v2 03/18] fuse: don't move a folio with PG_rcu_free into a fuse file

reviews.author: David Hildenbrand (Arm)
reviews.summary: Suggested removing fuse_try_move_folio() entirely and disallowing converting ordinary pages to folios and vice versa for future changes.

2026-11-04.patch_summary: The patch series aims to improve the handling of folios in the FUSE file system, specifically addressing issues related to moving folios with PG_rcu_free into fuse files. The current implementation has a bug where such folios can be copied by lockless page cache reads before they leave the page cache. The proposed solution is to copy such folios instead of moving them.

reviews.author: Linus Torvalds
reviews.summary: Agreed with David's suggestion and proposed removing pipe_buf_try_steal() entirely, considering it not useful.
reviews.raw_body:
On Mon, 9 Nov 2026 at 06:46, David Hildenbrand (Arm) <david@kernel.org> wrote:
>
> Could we get rid of fuse_try_move_folio() entirely?

Please. That would be great.

              Linus

2026-11-09.patch_summary: The patch series aims to improve the handling of folios in the FUSE file system, specifically addressing issues related to moving folios with PG_rcu_free into fuse files. The current implementation has a bug where such folios can be copied by lockless page cache reads before they leave the page cache. The proposed solution is to copy such folios instead of moving them.
